column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the utterance of Yahweh” is rendered “The LORD says,” and NASB capitalizes “my Lord” and “Your.”
NASB adds “saying”; “the staff of your strength” is rendered “Your strong scepter.”

The Hebrew is difficult: “your people [are] freewill offerings” is rendered “will volunteer freely,” and “to you [is] the dew of your youth” as “Your youth are to You as the dew.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “he will not repent” is rendered “will not change His mind,” and “manner” as “order.”
Close to the Hebrew; the present “he shatters” is rendered as future.
“It is full [of] corpses” is rendered “He will fill them with corpses,” and “the chief over the great earth” as “the chief men over a broad country.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a head” is rendered “His head.”
